quote.by: Benjamin Franklin, Advice to a Young Tradesman (1748)

items.title: TDS returns for Jul–Sep 2026 due 31 Oct 2026 in new Forms 138, 140 and 144
items.body: From tax year 2026-27, TDS statements are filed in Form 138 (salary), Form 140 (resident non-salary) and Form 144 (payments to non-residents), replacing Forms 24Q, 26Q and 27Q. The quarterly due dates are 31 July, 31 October, 31 January and 31 May.

items.title: MCA extends FY 2025-26 filings: AOC-4 till 31 Dec 2026, MGT-7/7A till 31 Jan 2027
items.body: MCA General Circular No. 05/2026 dated 24 October 2026 allows AOC-4 (all variants) to be filed up to 31 December 2026 and MGT-7 / MGT-7A up to 31 January 2027 without additional fees. The time for holding the AGM is not extended, and filings after the extended dates attract additional fees counted from the original due date.

items.title: 57th GST Council recommends removing arrest provisions and cutting general penalty to ₹10,000
items.body: At its 8 October 2026 meeting the GST Council recommended omitting the power of arrest, raising the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore and reducing the maximum general penalty from ₹25,000 to ₹10,000. Refund of accumulated ITC on input services in inverted-duty cases is proposed for credit availed on or after 1 November 2026. These are recommendations and take effect only when notified.

items.title: RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%; stance now 'calibrated tightening'
items.body: On 7 October 2026 the Monetary Policy Committee raised the policy repo rate to 5.50%; the SDF rate is 5.25% and the MSF rate and Bank Rate 5.75%. Loans linked to the repo rate may cost more from their next reset date.

items.title: AY 2026-27 audit cases: tax audit report by 21 Oct 2026, income tax return by 21 Nov 2026
items.body: On 28 September 2026 CBDT extended the due date for tax audit reports for AY 2026-27 from 30 September to 21 October 2026, and the return due date for audit cases from 31 October to 21 November 2026. The extension does not apply to other taxpayers.
